score_contract: A=max(required known normalized factors), C=1-A; all required factors known or full arm unknown. No labels, attack flags, schedules, masks, clean counterpart or evaluator outcome in scorer/state.

transform.convention: T_B_from_A, metres; validated R01/R02 Mixed Signals adapter
transform.frame_source: raw native PCD and causal odometry

density.fallback: same sensor and radial range, sector pooled only

geometry.fallback: same sensor across supported gaps only
geometry.history: previous valid cloud from same replay arm, even if anomalous; no clean shadow

reference_fit.source: actual clean reader -> causal eligibility -> raw D/G

calibration.source: separate actual clean segment through same reader, factors, normalization, EWMA warm-up and missingness
calibration.alarm: known anomaly strictly greater than threshold; ties quiet
calibration.no_power: threshold=1 or all constant; report, do not retune
calibration.threshold_scope: fold x sensor x method arm x memoryless/EWMA x reference version

temporal.sensitivity_rule: named recalibrated arms; all frozen before comparison

replay.seed_key: SHA256(segment US principal US filename US family US severity_.12g US replicate); first 16 hex digits seed PCG64; independent of traversal
replay.target: sender-only first 3 s most occupied D cell; deterministic cell tie-break
replay.writer: ASCII float32 XYZ intensity, 9 significant decimal digits; production reader recheck; 1e-6 identity tolerance

benign.schedule: same sustained and burst intervals for paired stress displays; natural clean always included
benign.separation: distinct from malicious and from clean reference/calibration
benign.R03_scope_note: R03 executed +10 ms pose-availability delay only; R05 clock-skew stress is a new predeclared modeled alignment scenario, not a measured timing error

prediction_seal: For all folds and all named arms, hash raw/normalized/instantaneous/temporal/alarm/eligibility records and checkpoints before evaluator joins; failed cells sealed as failures. No fold outcome inspection until all fold seals complete.

metrics.attempted_recall: alarms during scheduled nonzero intervention / every scheduled event including failures
metrics.realized_recall: alarms / reader-valid scheduled events with nonzero realized change
metrics.episode_recall: at least one known in-window alarm / all attempted positive episodes; separate realized-nonzero population
metrics.clean_and_benign_fpr: alarms / known eligible; also alarms / all attempts and eligible time
metrics.delay: first new eligible in-window alarm minus attempted onset; separate first-realized onset; right censor at offset/end
metrics.recovery: after last offset, eligible nonalarm continuously 2 s with no unknown/reset/gap > 0.5 s; otherwise undefined/censored
metrics.undefined: null with explicit reason and contributing counts, never zero by substitution

resampling.unit: broadest identifiable acquisition group; never frames
resampling.primary: individual C0-C3, equal-weight macro, range, leave-one-segment sensitivity
resampling.optional: fixed-seed 2000 paired group resamples, descriptive only if >1 independent group

report_selection.all_cells: all 4 folds x 5 families x 3 severities x 2 schedules, zero controls, clean, all benign stresses and every honest companion
report_selection.figures: predeclared first,middle,last scheduled event plus first failed and first known alarm by acquisition order; all failures and outcomes remain in full tables
report_selection.aggregation: C0-C3 individual and equal-weight macro; frame-weighted micro separately labeled; H separate

resource_plan.retention: retain original archives, one extracted segment, one active derived episode, compact ledgers; no silent archive deletion
resource_plan.resource_disposition: R05/R06 acquisition blocked pending explicit authorization and actual retention budget; R04 freezes without downloads
